title: Perturbation of the time-1 map of a generic volume-preserving $3$-dimensional Anosov flow
summary: Let $s > 1$ be a large integer, and let $f$ be a diffeomorphism sufficiently close in the $C^{s}$-topology to the time-1 map of a $C^{s}$ generic volume-preserving Anosov flow on a $3$-dimensional compact manifold. We show that for any probability measure $μ$ with smooth density, $f^n_* μ$ converges exponentially fast to a common limit measure with full support.
